content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the BECIL Various Posts Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 14-10-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of BECIL to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by Broadcast Engineering Consultants India Limited (BECIL) for deployment in Central Government Hospital Delhi/NCR.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available under BECIL Advt No 560?
faq.answer: A total of 22 vacancies have been announced for various posts including Residential Supervisor, Cook, Kitchen Attendant, and Driver.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply online for BECIL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for submission of online applications is 14-10-2026. Candidates must complete their application process before this date.

faq.question: Q4. What is the minimum qualification required for Kitchen Attendant?
faq.answer: Candidates applying for the Kitchen Attendant post must have passed 10th / Matriculation from a recognized Board or Institution.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for SC/ST and PWD candidates?
faq.answer: The application fee for SC, ST, and PWD candidates is NIL, whereas other categories are required to pay Rs. 295/-.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for the Driver post?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Driver (BUS/Ambulance/Truck/Heavy Vehicles) post will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 26,208/-.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any age relaxation applicable for the posts?
faq.answer: Age limits vary by post up to a maximum of 35 to 40 years. Please check the official notification for category-wise relaxation details if applicable.

faq.question: Q8. How can I apply for BECIL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates can apply online by visiting the official registration portal at becilregistration.in and completing the step-by-step application procedure.

faq.question: Q9. What is the mode of selection for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process includes scrutiny and shortlisting of applications, followed by an interview, assessment, skill test, or other evaluation methods.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I download the official notification PDF?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be downloaded directly from the Important Links section provided in this recruitment article.
